# Teething Issues

> Practice support for UK dental practices, developed by dental care professionals. Every call
> answered, CQC compliance kept up all year, staff hired, trained and tracked, a Sales Engine that
> finds and closes the leaks, and more visibility on Google, ChatGPT and social media.

Teething Issues works with UK dental practice owners, practice managers and dental entrepreneurs.
The founder began as a dental nurse, worked every role in a practice through to practice manager,
is a former CQC Registered Manager, has 15+ years inside dental practices, and helped grow a
practice's revenue to £135,000 a month. Teething Issues is registered with the ICO (C2051112) and
agrees a data processing agreement with every practice. Company: TEETHING ISSUES LTD (17496042).

## Departments

- Reception department: https://teethingissues.com/receptionist/
  A telephone receptionist that answers the calls the team can't get to (lunch, after five),
  speaks multiple languages, spots emergencies and sends the team a summary of every call. It only
  answers from what it has been taught and never gives medical advice. Upgrade: chases FTAs,
  fills cancellations and books appointments. £1,500 set-up, then £150 a month. Demo line: 020 4572 1391.
- Compliance department: https://teethingissues.com/compliance/
  Keeps a practice CQC inspection-ready all year across 14 areas: documents read line by line,
  every gap given a named owner and deadline, staff files right for every role, renewals flagged
  early, mock inspections.
- Management department: https://teethingissues.com/management/
  Hiring, onboarding and the practice inbox: the right people found, new starters set up properly
  from day one, staff training tracked, inbox kept clear with replies drafted for approval.
- Growth department (the Sales Engine): https://teethingissues.com/growth-department/
  Every FTA chased, every KPI tracked daily, the leaks found and closed, sales training for the
  team when conversion drops, progress tracked, and barriers like price and finance overcome.
- Google & ChatGPT visibility: https://teethingissues.com/ai-visibility/
  A ChatGPT visibility audit and fixes for one dental practice, proven with a dated before-and-after.
  £1,500 one-off, optional £150 a month.
- Social media department: https://teethingissues.com/twin/
  A digital twin of the practice owner, in their face and voice, making practice videos, with an
  approval hub so nothing posts without a yes. £1,500 set-up, then £150 a month for 4 videos.
- Teething Issues Circle: https://teethingissues.com/circle/
  A community on Skool for UK dental practice owners and managers: courses on CQC, team and growth,
  a monthly live Q&A. £97 a month with access for the whole team.

## Packages

Practices choose areas together at a 30-minute growth chat: Starter (2 areas) £1,999, Growth
(5 areas) £4,995, Complete (every area) £9,995, each then a £300 a month care plan. Set up in about
a week, with a growth expert alongside for the first month. No tie-in after the first month.
Nobody gets replaced: everything is there to make the team's day easier.
